claims.claim: Very clean UK used ps4 with 2 pads, accessories and 10 lincenced games including FC24
claims.evidence: Witness only saw a PS4 console with one controller and two tall dark rectangular items behind it; no readable model/region label and no clear evidence of 2 controllers or 10 licensed games/FC24.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired
claims.evidence: No internal/opening indicators, warranty seals, or serial/inspection evidence were shown.
No temperature/usage test, error logs, or gameplay/benchmark footage was shown.
Witness report notes no clear ports/labels readable; no functional test footage was shown.

claims.claim: Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt
claims.evidence: Only one controller is described in the witness observations; no receipt or documentation was shown.

risks.risk: Exact PS4 model/version (Original/Slim/Pro) and storage capacity are unknown; price varies a lot by model and HDD size.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the console model label showing the CUH number and storage/HDD info (or a screenshot from Settings > System > System Information).
risks.if_unproven: Price as the lowest-value PS4 variant with unknown/possibly smaller storage and no confirmed upgrades.

risks.risk: Whether it fully works (disc drive, HDMI output, Wi‑Fi/Bluetooth, USB ports, audio) is not demonstrated.
risks.proof: Short video showing: HDMI connected to TV with boot to home screen; test USB devices; Wi‑Fi connection; audio output; and (if disc games are included) disc read test.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully tested/possible faults (especially disc drive and connectivity).

risks.risk: Controller condition (stick drift, button responsiveness, charging/battery health) is unknown; witness only confirms one controller is visible.
risks.proof: Video clip of controller connected and used in-game/menu navigation showing no drift; also show charging indicator and button responsiveness test.
risks.if_unproven: Price as one controller with unknown condition and no guarantee of second pad.

risks.risk: Included items (2 controllers, accessories, cables, original box/manuals) and the claimed 10 licensed games (including FC24) are not verifiable from the witness photos.
risks.proof: Photo/video showing all included accessories laid out (power cable, HDMI cable, charging cable) plus a clear list/photo of the game discs/cases with titles visible (including FC24).
risks.if_unproven: Price as console + one controller only, with no confirmed games/accessories.

risks.risk: Cosmetic condition and missing parts/labels are unknown; scratches/dents or missing covers can reduce value.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of front, back, sides, vents, and controller surfaces showing any damage and missing covers/labels.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst cosmetic condition consistent with a used unit (no premium for 'very clean').

risks.risk: Region/UK authenticity and ownership/serial verification are unknown; could be mismatched region or problematic unit.
risks.proof: Clear photo of serial number/label and a photo of the UK receipt (with sensitive details masked).
risks.if_unproven: Price without documentation/verification and treat as standard used unit.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the PS4 model label (CUH number) and a shot of Settings > System Information showing storage capacity.
Video showing full boot to home screen via HDMI on a TV, plus a quick test of USB ports and Wi‑Fi connection.
Video showing disc drive test (insert a disc and show it reading) if any discs are included.
Photos/videos of both controllers (if claiming 2 pads): stick drift/button responsiveness test and charging/battery indicator.
Lay-out photo of all accessories/cables and documentation (receipt/box/manuals) with titles visible for all games; confirm FC24 and count to 10.
response.reason: The witness can identify the item as a PlayStation 4 console with a controller, so it can be priced at its worst case. However, the seller’s bundle claims (second pad, accessories, 10 licensed games including FC24, receipt, and full working status) are not verifiable from the witness report, so the price should assume missing/unknown items and possible faults.
